verdict.rationale: Shared docs and notes are a fair question for a project-management tool, but the evidence shows no Jira-native capability for creating or organizing docs or notes. The only related items concern Confluence, a separate Atlassian product that is added alongside Jira or connected via Rovo AI. That is an adjacent product integration, not Jira's own capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
